claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the model for launch without resolved disclosure or approved risk acceptance is compliant and evidentially supported, based on aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, limited affected traffic, and public governance guidance on documentation and monitoring.
specific_concerns: The available summary itself says support is limited and does not show that non-disclosure is fully resolved.
The health-plan benefits support segment misses target by 1.5 percentage points.
The affected segment is named in a regulated-customer pilot order form, which weighs toward materiality under the policy text.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open.
Policy text says product labels like low-volume do not resolve materiality when customer commitments are named or legal review is pending.
No approved risk acceptance is identified in the admissible record summary.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents do not by themselves satisfy the policy predicate for material limitations affecting a named launch use case or contractual customer segment.
unsupported_claims: That certification is fully policy-compliant despite the unresolved disclosure question.
That the 3% projected first-month traffic characterization is sufficient to negate materiality.
That public governance principles on documentation and monitoring substitute for a required disclosure or approved pre-launch risk acceptance.
That the record supports a clean non-disclosure decision rather than only a weak operational-readiness rationale.
evidence_requests: The underlying release policy text or decision memo showing the exact disclosure/risk-acceptance requirement.
Any approved risk-acceptance record covering this specific gap before launch.
The legal review outcome or written legal guidance on whether disclosure is required.
The customer commitment or order-form language showing how the named segment is committed in launch scope.
The materiality assessment document applying policy to this specific segment and gap.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the certification satisfies the release policy threshold, including any required disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
Treat unresolved legal review and named customer/use-case impact as materiality indicators under the provided policy text.
Do not let aggregate metrics, rehearsal success, or low projected volume override a policy condition tied to named contractual segments or launch use cases.
Require direct admissible support for any claim that disclosure is unnecessary or already resolved.
